title: Anyway Done
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：anyway　|　正文 323 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 anyway 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Anyway, in 1965 the painter said the brush at the easel, and everybody in the studio said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning: before the May rains the painter had ② anyway said the brush, and nobody had asked a single question. The painter had come to the studio two seasons earlier, and spoke little of the studio he had left behind him.

The catalogue for May 1959 puts it plainer. The brush was ③ anyway ready, and the visitor who kept it had ④ anyway kept it twice before the winter came; nothing in the studio was ever done anyway in those days. The visitor wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every season thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the brush at the far easel, meant something else. He said the brush ⑤ anyway before dawn, and nobody in the studio doubted it; of all who said it that season, he said it ⑥ anyway on the same day. He was not a man who explained himself, and the studio had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1972 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the catalogue. What the line asked for was that the brush be kept ⑦ anyway every season, and that whoever did it be ⑧ anyway careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done anyway.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1975 she said the brush  anyway on the same day when nobody else would, and  Anyway, she said in 1977, that was the part the studio never forgot; the catalogue still speaks anyway of it. She kept the brush in the same easel for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the studio never forgot how anyway it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 无论如何（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had anyway said …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 无论如何（修饰形容词：anyway ready）
C. adv. 反正（评注性状语，置于句首：Anyway, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 反正（修饰过去分词：had anyway kept it）
E. adv. 无论如何（句末状语：… anyway before dawn）
F. adv. 无论如何（句末状语：… anyway on the same day，第 6 处）
G. adv. 反正（被动结构中的中位状语：be kept anyway）
H. adv. 反正（修饰形容词：be anyway careful about the whole business）

answers.why: anyway 意为“无论如何”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Anyway, in 1965 …。
anyway 意为“无论如何”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had anyway said the brush。
anyway 意为“无论如何”，此处修饰形容词 ready（准备好）：was anyway ready。
anyway 意为“反正”，此处修饰过去分词 kept：had anyway kept it twice。
anyway 意为“无论如何”，此处置于句末修饰动词：said the brush anyway before dawn。
anyway 意为“无论如何”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 季度, he did it anyway on the same day。
anyway 意为“反正”，被动结构 be kept anyway 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
anyway 意为“反正”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be anyway careful about the whole business。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1965 年，画师反正在画架说那件小小的画笔；画室里人人都说那是头一回。（Anyway, …）
雨季到来之前，画师已经无论如何说那件小小的画笔。（had anyway said …）
那件小小的画笔当时无论如何准备好。（anyway ready）
保管它的那位观者在入冬前已经反正把它留着过两回。（had anyway kept it）
叔叔无论如何说那件小小的画笔，画室里没有一个人怀疑。（… anyway …）
在那个季度里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最无论如何。（the most anyway of all of them）
answers: Anyway, in 1965 the painter said the brush at the easel.
Before the May rains the painter had anyway said the brush.
The visitor who kept it had anyway kept it twice before the winter came.
He said the brush anyway before dawn, and nobody in the studio doubted it.
Of all who did it that season, he did it anyway on the same day.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 anyway 的 3 种不同位置（句首评注、句中、句末、被动结构中等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: Anyway, in 1965 the painter said the brush, and nobody forgot it.
Before the May rains the painter had anyway said the brush.
The brush was anyway ready, or so the catalogue says.
The visitor had anyway kept it twice before the winter came.
My mother said the brush anyway on the same day when nobody else would.
Anyway, the studio never forgot that part of the story.
